entries.title: Dungeons and raids scale to your group size, with solo modes
entries.body: Content Scaling is on by default. Switch it off on the Manager's Modules page to keep stock difficulty.

entries.title: NPC Enchanter may say an empty line on servers without its config file
entries.body: Copy npc_enchanter.conf.dist to npc_enchanter.conf, or let the Manager create it.
